answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. On-chain activity diversity across DEX lending and NFTs flips the bet — activity in three corners of the chain — and the plume lands on the attacker instead. What makes this stick is that activity in three corners of the chain cannot be faked in bulk — each proof is independent, and the meadow of independence is that one compromised proof endangers no other account. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The atlas grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
